decisive_items: Mild hypoaesthesia on the extensor side of the knee and ankle
Earlobe tissue fluid showed acid-fast bacilli (Bacterial Index 4.8)
response.rationale: Chronic painless nodules with foamy histiocyte infiltrates, abundant AFB, high bacterial index, and hypoaesthesia are diagnostic of leprosy; other candidates lack this combination.

rejected.why: Erythema nodosum is a painful septal panniculitis, usually on shins, and does not produce AFB-laden histiocytes or hypoaesthesia.
Sarcoidosis shows non-caseating epithelioid granulomas and would not have abundant acid-fast bacilli; the foamy histiocyte AFB-rich infiltrate excludes it.
Erythema nodosum leprosum is an acute painful reaction with fever/tenderness, whereas these nodules are painless and chronic without systemic symptoms.
Lupus erythematosus may account for autoantibodies but not for the AFB-laden histiocytic infiltrates, high BI, or hypoaesthesia.
Lupus vulgaris is a paucibacillary cutaneous tuberculosis with tuberculoid granulomas; abundant AFB, high BI, and hypoaesthesia strongly favor leprosy.
